note: Afghanistan, read on 2026-10-31 on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' site (mfa.gov.af, in Pashto), its pages 'Types of visa' and 'Residence visa' (استوګنې وېزه). The Ministry's visa section issues and extends visas for foreign nationals. The residence visa is given to foreign nationals who, to continue their residence in Afghanistan, have used the service, business, entry, study or flight-crew visas (one route, `general`, since it serves whichever purpose brought them). Its validity is from one month to one year of residence (a range, so no term is written), and its price is 50 US dollars a month (a monthly charge, not one fee for a grant, so no fee is written). Where it is applied for, its renewal and the work it allows aren't stated, and there is no permanent route on these pages. The Ministry of Interior's Passport Department, which the earlier search named, wasn't read.
